LESSON: READING 14.2.1 STUDY SKILLS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.2: Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills, part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to summarise information? 2. How can key points be identified in a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify the main ideas in a descriptive text,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. make notes from a descriptive text,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. summarise a descriptive text in a paragraph of stated number of words,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. acknowledge the role of note making and summarise texts. ● Guide the learners to read a descriptive text on safety in sports and identify the key points. ● Guide the learners to discuss in groups steps to follow when making notes and writing summaries. ● Guide the learners to search for and read samples of well written summaries and notes in print or in braille. ● Learners share ideas on qualities of well written notes and summaries. ● Guide the learner to make notes from a descriptive text. ● Learners combine the points into a coherent paragraph using connectors to make a summary in a specified number of words. ● Guide the learners to display the paragraphs in class for peer review. 1. Why is it important to summarise information? 2. How can key points be identified in a text?

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn is achieved as learners display their paragraphs for peer review.

● Self-efficacy is enhanced as learners make notes and summarise to improve their study skills.
